text: Bitcoin's modest 1.4% decline contrasts with Ethereum's steadier hold at -0.4%, suggesting traders are rotating away from BTC toward alts despite minor pressure across the board. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 56 but has cooled 18 points over the week, indicating sentiment is shifting from euphoria toward caution. Bitcoin dominance at 58.5% with $99B in daily volume shows healthy liquidity, but the divergence in losses between BTC and ETH hints that conviction in the broader rally is wavering.
